metadata.title: Cisplatin 40 mg/m² Weekly with Radiotherapy
metadata.indication: Concurrent chemoradiation for NCCP-listed cervical, bladder, nasopharyngeal and unresectable head-and-neck indications; select the exact indication.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.

contexts.duration_text: 5 weekly doses with RT; additional concurrent doses only at Consultant discretion

provenance.source: NCCP regimen PDF / Head and Neck catalogue

metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent clinical/pharmacy review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: NCCP version 5 reconciled to executable thresholds, eligibility, monitoring, RT coordination and explicit local safety guards; independent clinical/pharmacy approval remains pending.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or the specialist authority specified in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Discuss all changes with the Consultant. The output states source percentages, not a prescription; do not multiply independent reductions, infer a restart dose, substitute eGFR for CrCl, or apply another cisplatin regimen’s thresholds.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding includes NCCP 00385 Version 5. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: Definitive chemoradiation for locally advanced cervical squamous, adenosquamous or adenocarcinoma, stage IIB–IVA; selected IB3/IIA only after MDT discussion.
Chemoradiation for locally advanced bladder cancer.
Chemoradiation for locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma.
Chemoradiation for locally advanced unresectable head-and-neck squamous carcinoma when three-weekly cisplatin cannot be tolerated.
Postoperative adjuvant chemoradiation for cervical squamous, adenosquamous or adenocarcinoma with unexpected pathological node positivity.

treatment.schedule_summary: Cisplatin 40 mg/m² every 7 days during RT: 5 cycles for cervical cancer (extension only by Consultant); 6 cycles for bladder, nasopharyngeal and head-and-neck disease.
treatment.rt_coordination: Give cisplatin before RT on the same day. If RT is cancelled, postpone cisplatin until RT resumes.
